text:
miguel_pm: Quick sync — proposing a small ISV sandbox pilot: onboard one LangChain runner + a gateway adapter from GateFlow, validate orchestration (canary + fallback) and marketplace packaging. Looking for volunteers from eng + partnerships to scope.

alex_m: I'm in. Need checklist for marketplace listing, compliance, co-marketing assets. :thumbsup:

jin_eng: Re: adapter — I can do the integration work. Can you share expected API surface? Is it the Gateway v2 contract? Also sequence length/throughput targets pls.

miguel_pm: Yes Gateway v2. Targets: 250ms p50, 800ms p95 on Redwood Dedicated small reserve. Throughput 30 req/s baseline. We'll run functional tests then perf with 1k prompts.

tara_ops: I'll own the pilot runbook + monitoring dashboards. Need to define eval prompts and quality gates (top-1 / hallucination threshold).

alex_m: Co-marketing ask: JS + Python quickstarts, partner blog, joint webinar in Q2. Need NDA ok.

partner_bot: @miguel_pm You have a pending partner NDA with GateFlow, expires in 7 days.

jin_eng: Adapter config sketch:
```yaml
adapter:
  name: gateflow-v2
  endpoint: https://adapter.example.com/v2
  auth: bearer {{GATEFLOW_TOKEN}}
  features: [streaming, function_calling, kv_cache]
```
Will prototype this week.

miguel_pm: Perfect. Also want to test LangChain/LLamaIndex connectors — primary use case: searchable convo memory + retrieval-augmented generation. Will need embeddings flow: Redwood embeddings -> vector DB (we'll use Pinecone for pilot).

tara_ops: Also plan infra: Dedicated pool (g4dn-like) + fallback to hosted with rate-limits. I'll set up routing policy: prefer dedicated, fallback to hosted low-cost model if capacity spike >70%.

alex_m: Risks: vendor marketplace listing timelines (legal review), GateFlow needs OA to include our SDK snippets in their docs. Who owns SDK PR?

jin_eng: I'll open PR in rdw-sdk repo for adapter and example. ETA EOD Friday.

miguel_pm: Great. Action items:
- jin_eng: adapter PR + integration tests (EOD Fri)
- tara_ops: runbook + dashboards + routing policy draft (Mon)
- alex_m: co-marketing assets scope + NDA check (Mon)
- miguel_pm: coordinate GateFlow, schedule tech review (Mon)
Ping me if blockers.

tara_ops: For perf tests, recommend using these scripts:
```bash
ab -n 1000 -c 10 -p prompts.json https://redwood-dedicated/gateway
```

alex_m: +1 on webinar but recommend a short tech demo first. Also confirm joint announcement embargo date.

partner_bot: Reminder: Schedule tech review meeting invited to #partnerships-calendar for 2124689500.

jin_eng: One quick Q — for RAG evals, do we have a baseline metric? I suggest using MRR on retrieval + human eval for hallucinations.

miguel_pm: Baseline: MRR 0.72, hallucination rate <5% on 200 sample queries. We'll set pass/fail.

alex_m: ok locking embargo: target announcement week of 2024-05-13 pending successful pilot.

tara_ops: I'll mock dashboard widgets and post screenshots to the thread tomorrow.

miguel_pm: Thanks everyone. I'll update the PR list in this thread. :rocket:
